patch.content:
# Copyright 2021 Google LLC
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

description: Zephyr ADC Emulator

compatible: "zephyr,adc-emul"

include: adc-controller.yaml

properties:
  nchannels:
    type: int
    required: true
    description: Number of ADC channels. Must be between 1 and 32.

  ref-internal-mv:
    type: int
    default: 0
    description: |
      Internal reference voltage in mV. 0 means internal reference is not
      supported.

  ref-vdd-mv:
    type: int
    default: 0
    description: |
      VDD reference voltage in mV. 0 means VDD reference is not supported.

  ref-external0-mv:
    type: int
    default: 0
    description: |
      External 0 reference voltage in mV. 0 means external 0 reference is not
      supported.

  ref-external1-mv:
    type: int
    default: 0
    description: |
      External 1 reference voltage in mV. 0 means external 1 reference is not
      supported.

  "#io-channel-cells":
    const: 1

io-channel-cells:
  - input
